blocks.text: This article provides information on configuring and managing Azure accounts using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see API Rate Limit Summary.
Before configuring and managing Azure accounts, make sure you've identified the access token required for authorization.

blocks.item: Send a POST request to the following endpoint:
/publicCloudTenant
Include the request headers to provide information about the request context:
Content Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Use the following JSON payload to create an Azure account and provide the following information:
PublicCloudTenant:
(Required) name (String): The name of the Azure account.
(Required) cloudType (String): The cloud type. The default value is AZURE.
(Required) tenantDetails:
applicationId (String): The application ID of the Azure account.
applicationSecret (String): The application secret of the Azure account.
azureDirectoryId (String): The directory ID of the Azure account.
(Required) subscriptionGroups:
name (String): The name of the subscription group. The name is automatically set to <azure_account_name>_default, overriding any value you provide.
cloudType (String): The cloud type. The default value is AZURE.
supportedRegions (List): Regions supported by the Zscaler Tag Discovery Service.
id (Integer): The unique ID of the supported region.
subscriptionList (List): The list of Azure subscriptions.
externalId (String): The ID of the Azure subscription.
name (String): The name of the Azure subscription.
(Optional) cloudConnectorGroupList (List):
ID (Integer): The ID of the Cloud & Branch Connector group.

nameSpace (String): The namespace that limits the IP addresses sent to the Cloud Connector and ensures that duplicate IP addresses map correctly. The value will be null if you don’t provide a name space.
(Optional) publicCloudTopics:
region (List):
id (Integer): The unique ID of the region.
resourceGroup (String): The resource group associated with the event grid.
subscription (String): The subscription associated with the event grid.
(Optional) publicCloudStorageAccounts:
name (String): The name of the Azure storage account.
subscription (String): The subscription where the storage account is located.
resourceGroup (String): The resource group associated with the storage account.
region (List):
id (Integer): The unique ID of the region.
prefix (String): A prefix added to the name of the storage account, which enables you to organize the queues. The value is null if you don’t provide a prefix.
Creating an Azure Account

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 201, meaning the Azure account is created. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

blocks.heading: Getting Details for All Azure Accounts

blocks.item: To get details for all Azure accounts, send a GET request to the following endpoint:
/publicCloudTenant
This API supports pagination. To get a paginated response, send a GET request to the following endpoint:
/publicCloudTenant?page=1&pagesize=2

blocks.heading: Getting Details of a Specific Azure Account

blocks.text: To get details for a particular Azure Account:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint:
/publicCloudTenant/{id}
Provide the unique ID of the Azure account in the request endpoint:
For example:
/publicCloudTenant/100

To update a specific Azure account:

blocks.item: Provide the updated JSON payload from the Creating an Azure Account section and send a PUT request to the following endpoint:
/publicCloudTenant/{id}
Provide the unique ID of the Azure account, subscription, topic, and storage account in the request payload.

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 204. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

blocks.item: Send a DELETE request to the following endpoint:
/publicCloudTenant/{id}
Provide the unique ID of the Azure account in the request endpoint:
For example:
/publicCloudTenant/100

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 204. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
The following table provides details of additional Azure APIs that you can use to perform various operations:

table: Retrieve a list of Azure supported regions
Send a GET request to /publicCloudTenant/supportedRegions. The GET request retrieves details such as cloud type, region ID, and region name.
Retrieve a list of Azure resource groups

Send a POST request to /discoveryService/azure/{region}/resourceGroups. Provide the Azure region name in the request endpoint and subscription ID and credential details ( azureDirectoryId, applicationId, and applicationSecret) in the request payload.
Retrieve the list of Azure storage accounts

Send a POST request to /discoveryService/azure/{region}/storageAccounts. Provide the Azure region name in the request endpoint and subscription ID and credential details (azureDirectoryId, applicationId, and applicationSecret) in the request payload.
Send a PUT request to /discoveryService/azure/{region}/topicSync?tenantId={id}. Provide the Azure region name and tenant ID in the request endpoint.
Verify whether the provided Azure credentials are valid and can scan tags for Azure subscriptions.
Send a POST request to /discoveryService/azure/tenantPermission. Provide Azure tenant ID and credential details (azureDirectoryId, applicationId, and applicationSecret) in the request payload.
